primary_prediction_metric.name: preferred_mix_top1_accuracy
primary_prediction_metric.winner_definition: human actual_top_tie_set derived from maximum A-E rating
primary_prediction_metric.numerator: count of scorable predictions whose predicted_preferred_mix is in actual_top_tie_set
primary_prediction_metric.denominator: count of scorable joined rows for the method/condition under analysis

primary_ranking_metric.name: spearman_rank_correlation
primary_ranking_metric.human_rank_handling: average ranks for tied human ratings
primary_ranking_metric.predicted_rank_handling: explicit prediction order A-E to ranks 1..5; rating-derived predicted ties may use average ranks as a diagnostic

excluded_models.centaur: native likelihood/probability outputs are not 0-100 ratings and must not be converted into fake ratings

personalisation_metric.unit: paired held-out prediction_example_id within each model
personalisation_metric.statistical_design_for_later_phase: paired within-example comparison; no significance testing in Phase 6H.1
